newsitem.title: USA: W.W. Grainger off as Q1 disappoints.
newsitem.headline: W.W. Grainger off as Q1 disappoints.

text.p: Shares of W.W. Grainger Inc were off more than five points Friday morning after the company's first quarter earnings came in at the low end of analysts' estimates.
The company reported net income of $1.03 a share, up from $0.98 a year earlier but below the First Call mean estimate of $1.08. First Call estimates ranged from $1.03 to $1.11 a share.
Grainger officials were not available for comment on the stock's slide.
The shares were off 4-7/8 at 71-3/8 and had traded as low as 70-1/2.
Grainger provides maintenance, repair and operating supplies to a variety of industries.
